title: App and Main
description: Study the implementation in [app.py] and [main.py]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include to_table, index, chart, site_index, site_console, site_assets, _dashboard, api_summary, main; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in app.py, main.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
